files.help:
This directory is made by either Pico-8, Picotron or Voxatron.
Alias whichever program being used to use a custom data location:

```bash
alias pico8=pico8 -home "$XDG_DATA_HOME"/pico-8
alias picotron=picotron -home "$XDG_DATA_HOME"/picotron
alias vox=vox -home "$XDG_DATA_HOME"/voxatron
```
